title: One stage as a chest of drawers
label: A wide plan chest on four feet: four deep 8 B drawers (sdfField, rawGradient, blurA, blurB), a spacer, three shallow 4 B drawers (source, scratch, frosted), recessed side panels and a gridded top holding the glass pass output pill.
caption: Each drawer is one render target, as tall as its bytes per texel and filled from the bottom in the order the passes write them. Move across the chest to slide each drawer out and see what its floor holds; the pill on top lights when the glass pass binds the open drawer.
